topbar.welcome_msg: FindIt — Your Trusted Lost & Found Community

hero.description: Report lost items, share found belongings, and help your community recover valuables quickly and safely.

footer.tagline: Helping communities reunite people with their lost belongings since 2024.
footer.rights_reserved: FindIt — Lost & Found Portal. All rights reserved.

profile.profile_subtitle: Manage your personal information and public profile

type.title: What would you like to post?
type.subtitle: Choose whether you lost something or found an item.
type.lost_desc: Report a missing item and ask the community for help finding it.
type.found_desc: Share a found item so the owner can identify and claim it.

details.title: Item details
details.subtitle: Describe the item clearly so others can recognize it.
details.placeholder_title: e.g. Lost iPhone 15 Pro — Space Black with blue case
details.placeholder_desc: Include distinctive features: color, brand, marks, contents, where you last saw it…
details.photos_limit: Up to 5 images · JPG, PNG · Max 5 MB each
details.offer_reward: Offer a reward for finding this item
details.urgent_desc: For time-sensitive items like pets, medication, or passports

location.title: Where & when?
location.subtitle: Help people narrow down the search area.
location.specific_placeholder: e.g. Near the fountain, Bus stop #12, Metro Barekamutyun
location.map_optional: Optional — click to drop a pin

contact.title: Contact information
contact.subtitle: How should people reach you? Your info is shown only after they contact you.
contact.terms_suffix: and confirm this listing is accurate. I understand that false reports may be removed.

preview.default_title: Your item title will appear here
preview.tip_1: Add clear, well-lit photos from multiple angles
preview.tip_2: Include unique identifiers (scratches, stickers, serial numbers)
preview.tip_3: Never share sensitive info like full ID numbers publicly
preview.tip_4: Meet in a safe public place when returning items

success_modal.title: Listing published!
success_modal.subtitle: Your item is now live. We'll notify you when someone responds.

auth.register_subtitle: Start posting and helping your community today.
auth.login_subtitle: Sign in to manage your listings and saved items.

branding.description: Join thousands of people helping reunite lost items with their owners every day.
branding.testimonial_text: Found my wallet within 2 hours thanks to a kind stranger who posted it here.

errors.image_size_limit: Image size must be less than 5MB.

errors.password_length: Password must be at least 8 characters.
